integrity: Closed-form all-order proof in RESULT.md and a reproducible exact-fraction finite checker. The checker corroborates but cannot replace the infinite-family argument.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns centered unweighted graph balls on crown graphs of order 2n, n>=3, with counting measure; no generalization to arbitrary edge deletions, weights, or uncentered maxima is claimed. Bibliographic priority remains provisional.
title: Exact weak-endpoint maximal inequalities on crown graphs
